items.text: Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.
Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.

2026-11-07.summary:
### Monuments & World
- Fixed terrain clipping in Nuclear Missile Silo doorways and underground tunnels, preventing doors from being blocked by terrain.

### Bug Fixes
- Encryption level is now applied on the network thread, preventing premature encryption setup and ensuring packet batches are flushed before sending, reducing connection errors.
- DirectDraw objects no longer render when attached to entities that haven’t been networked to the client yet, fixing visual glitches.

items.text: Night vision goggles now work reliably and no longer get stuck after use.
Sleeping bags can no longer be placed where a player wouldn't fit, and you won't respawn stuck on a sleeping bag that blocks space; a warning appears if placement would cause this.
Watercatcher and chicken coop trough now correctly select the bucket in your belt when opening the loot panel.
Flamethrower fuel gauge needle now accurately reflects remaining fuel.
Vending machine markers now appear above generic markers after reopening the map, improving map readability.
Floating City distance flares have been adjusted to prevent excessive brightness.
Restored the correct tooltip for disabled blueprints, informing players why a blueprint cannot be learned.
Fixed shutters showing incorrect frames when entering network range, ensuring visual state matches actual door status.

2026-11-06.summary:
### Equipment & Wearables
- Night vision goggles now work reliably and no longer get stuck after use.

### Deployables & Base Building
- Sleeping bags can no longer be placed where a player wouldn't fit, and you won't respawn stuck on a sleeping bag that blocks space; a warning appears if placement would cause this.
- Watercatcher and chicken coop trough now correctly select the bucket in your belt when opening the loot panel.

### UI & HUD
- Flamethrower fuel gauge needle now accurately reflects remaining fuel.

### Map & Markers
- Vending machine markers now appear above generic markers after reopening the map, improving map readability.

### Lighting & Visibility
- Floating City distance flares have been adjusted to prevent excessive brightness.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Restored the correct tooltip for disabled blueprints, informing players why a blueprint cannot be learned.
- Fixed shutters showing incorrect frames when entering network range, ensuring visual state matches actual door status.
